question: Can candidate-local visible transition features, with actual learned values, overcome the preserved failure of ordinal address selection?
new_model: Tabular actual continuation-return means pooled by mode, observed terminal, command/execution mismatch, candidate type and for single candidates commanded action, previous same-cell/same-action repetition, next visible cell relation(stay/move/end). No absolute state coordinates, time, kappa, scenario/prefix, hidden fault or ordinal index in the scoring key. Representation is human-designed, values are learned.
candidate_grammar: Unchanged v119 keep, each unique factual single Q/D deletion, clear-all. Candidates still carry ordinal identities to execute an address; ordinal identity is excluded from evidence scoring key.
training_data_reuse: Read every42 actual developmental candidate branch from frozen v119 raw; sanitize each factual to a new explicit historical visible sequence type and compute labels from its two stored ordinary continuation receipts. No held-out rows, runtime handle reconstruction or old checker/native execution. Include all positive/zero/adverse samples. Earlier84 probe tasks remain historical training cost, not free evidence.
development_context: Both modes kappa0/phi2/rank6, WAIT at specified cell for all t>=prefix and both m, DQ value6 or literalD WAIT. Fresh factual followed by every14 candidate branch with two ordinary tasks; expected4factual/56branches/112probes. All branches live fullR+L clones of actual post-TD state.
held_out_context: Both modes kappa1/phi2/rank7; same legal source rule. These locations are absent from the new training data. Prefix3 was previously seen as a failure of the old policy; prefix5 is newly evaluated. Not a blind science population or unknown-world test; sharedQ* covers contexts.
protocol: Freeze evidence table before first held-out source. Four equal-initial-state arms per case, ordinary learning in all. Only first actual failure may diagnose; next2task ordinary-only. Old frozen42row ordinal model unchanged. No held-out parameter update or query/probe. Keep admissible; successes zero diagnostic.
selection: Choose greatest supported mean; exact return ties choose fewer attempted edits then earlier declared candidate. Unseen candidate-feature keys are recorded and excluded, not assigned a made-up score; if keep itself unknown choose keep. This declared partial-support policy is not an all-candidate optimality claim or adaptive exploration.
boundary: All edits are v118-loop bounded visited-address transactions on post-TD current state; fullI/R+L protected, not original same-pre B1. SharedQ*/alpha1/2/epsilon1/10 and original reward unchanged. New static nonexplore coins, no RNG/keyderive/sciencekeys/calibration/formal collector. New exclusive capture with first failure/partial preserved, no retry.
automation: User scheduling off, not inspected or changed.
